messages:
ida: FYI we got two Dedicated customers with console build failures after the routing-policy telemetry change. tsc+webpack blowing up on duplicate types.
rashid: any repro links?
ida: https://gist.github.com/redwood/console-telemetry-repro-1819 — main error is "Duplicate identifier 'TelemetryEvent'" and ambiguous exports.
elaine: short-term options: (1) vendor a single telemetry impl in console canary, (2) publish a tiny compat shim that SDKs depend on, (3) switch telemetry to peerDependency and document expected versions.
tom: I vote for a compat shim + peerDependency. That avoids long-lived pinning and keeps SDK surface stable.
rashid: impl detail for TS: publish @redwood/telemetry-compat that re-exports a stable, small API. SDK uses that. Actual redwood-telemetry stays as a peerDep. Console canary can alias concrete impl -> compat to force single symbol.
elaine: Python mirror: publish redwood_telemetry_compat that lazy-imports telemetry_v2 or telemetry_v3 and provides a no-op fallback if missing. Keep extras_require so plain `pip install redwood-sdk` remains working.
ida: short-term unblock: we'll vendor telemetry into the hosted console canary while shims land. long-term we ship shims and add CI bundle tests.
tom: CI test idea: matrix entry that builds console with both telemetry v2 and v3 present in node_modules and fails if tsc/webpack duplicate symbol error occurs.
rashid: I'll open TS shim PR skeleton + unit tests. Tom takes Python shim. Elaine will handle console alias + CI change.
ida: notify support & CSE before canary so they can triage customer reported breakages.
devex-bot: created task card "telemetry-compat shims + CI" and scheduled reminder for Friday.
infra-bot: note: vendorizing in customer repos increases support burden. Recommend shims published within 48h and vendor only as emergency fallback.
ida: ok team, action items listed. We'll reconvene after initial PRs land. Thanks. :thumbsup:
